title: OpenLSR-X: Learnable 2D-to-3D Super-Resolution and Petrophysical Benchmark Suite for X-Ray Computed Tomography
description: Open-source PyTorch and PyTorch Lightning framework for 2D-to-3D super-resolution (SRGAN + 3-Axis Orthogonal Fourier Fusion) and quantitative petrophysical validation of porous-media and synchrotron X-ray computed tomography (XCT) volumes.
